nodes.text: Mind the lines. The run is under the shelf and the shelf is under your next step if you keep walking like that.

choices.text: What is wrong with the Darkwater?

nodes.text: Salmon, all winter, fat as luck. The gray water never quite closes over the run, the Kettle keeps a vein of it warm the whole way out. Same reason the town is here. Everything here is the same reason.

Nothing is wrong with it. That is the wrongness. No current, no birds, no ice even in the killing months. My mother said the far shore has a shore because something has to hold the water in. Nobody fishes it. Keep it that way.
Watch the plank on the second pier. It bites.
